items.headline: 同样大小的琴块，为什么音高不同？
items.summary: 11 月 19 日发表的研究把空气槽藏在 3D 打印琴块的振动板下方。改变槽的形状，板更容易弯曲，振动频率就会降低。同一组琴块不用改外形就能做出不同音高；两组样品合起来覆盖一个八度，最高频率是最低的两倍。
items.summary_en: In a study published on 19 November, researchers used hidden air slots beneath the vibrating plate of 3D-printed blocks. Changing the slots made the plate bend more easily and vibrate more slowly. Blocks of the same size could play different notes; across two size groups, the highest frequency was twice the lowest.

items.headline: 食卵蛇怎样剥掉吞下的蛋壳？
items.headline_en: How does an egg-eating snake crack a swallowed egg?
items.summary: 11 月 17 日，德国埃尔朗根-纽伦堡大学介绍了在埃塞俄比亚确认的新种白喉食卵蛇。食卵蛇吞下整颗蛋后，用伸入食道的椎骨突起压破蛋壳，再挤出蛋液，最后把空壳吐出。
items.summary_en: On 17 November, FAU reported a newly identified white-throated egg-eater from Ethiopia. Egg-eating snakes swallow eggs whole. Bony projections from the spine break the shell in the throat; the snake squeezes out the contents and spits out the empty shell.

items.headline: 给地图配四色，怎样更快？
items.headline_en: How fast can we colour a map?
items.summary: 平面地图只需四种颜色，就能让共用一段边界的区域颜色不同。11 月 13 日，日本国立信息学研究所公布，一种近线性配色算法获 FOCS 最佳论文奖。同一团队在另一篇预印本中让多次换色共用一次准备，把算法的计算量降到随区域数线性增长。
items.summary_en: Four colours suffice if regions sharing a stretch of border must differ. On 13 November, Japan’s National Institute of Informatics announced a FOCS Best Paper Award for a near-linear colouring algorithm. In a separate preprint, the team reuses the same setup for several colour swaps so that the work grows at most in proportion to the number of regions.

items.headline: 下雨怎样拆开海上的“遮阳棚”？
items.headline_en: How can rain break up the ocean’s sunshade?
items.summary: 海上的大片低云会把阳光反射回太空。欧洲航天局 11 月 19 日介绍，EarthCARE 的观测支持这样一个解释：雨滴会带走空气中帮助形成云滴的微粒。剩下的云滴更容易长大成雨滴，雨于是下得更多。连续云层变得破碎，更多阳光就能照到海面。
items.summary_en: Bright sheets of low cloud reflect sunlight back into space. On 19 November, ESA reported EarthCARE observations supporting an explanation: rain removes particles that help cloud droplets form. The remaining droplets can grow larger and produce more rain. As the cloud sheet breaks up, more sunlight reaches the ocean.

items.headline: 无人机的支架里也能装电池吗？
items.headline_en: Could a drone store energy in its landing gear?
items.summary: 11 月 18 日，韩国科学技术院介绍了一种能弯曲的锂硫电池电极。研究团队把纳米线直接长在柔软、导电的碳布上，再把做成的电池装进弯曲的无人机支架部件，成功点亮了一盏 LED。
items.summary_en: On 18 November, KAIST described a bendable lithium–sulfur battery electrode. The team grew nanowires directly on flexible, conductive carbon cloth. They fitted a cell made with the electrode into a curved drone-leg component and used it to light an LED.

items.headline: 破解密码的数学，怎样找到一颗脉冲星？
items.headline_en: How did code-breaking maths help find a pulsar?
items.summary: 11 月 19 日，NASA 介绍，研究人员把寻找微弱伽马射线脉冲的难题，转成在高维点阵里寻找最短向量的问题。他们借用密码学的算法分析了费米望远镜 15 年的数据，找到一颗每秒自转 261 圈的中子星。
items.summary_en: On 19 November, NASA reported that researchers turned the hunt for faint gamma-ray pulses into a geometry problem: finding the shortest vector in a high-dimensional grid of points. With an algorithm borrowed from cryptography and 15 years of Fermi data, they found a neutron star spinning 261 times a second.

previous_answers.headline: 三个不透明盒子分别装着两个红球、两个蓝球、一红一蓝。写着「两红」「两蓝」「一红一蓝」的三个标签都贴错了。你只能选一个盒子、不看里面摸出一个球。怎样确定三个盒子里各装了什么？
previous_answers.headline_en: Three opaque boxes contain two red balls, two blue balls, and one of each, respectively. The three labels, “two red”, “two blue” and “one of each”, are all wrong. You may choose one box and draw one ball without looking inside. How can you identify the contents of all three boxes?
previous_answers.explanation: 从贴着「一红一蓝」的盒子摸一个球。这盒不可能是混装，摸到什么颜色，整盒就是什么颜色。剩下两盒再按「标签都错」排除即可。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Draw from the box labelled “one of each”. It cannot be mixed, so the colour drawn identifies both balls. Use the other two wrong labels to place the remaining contents.
previous_answers.subject: W47 · 盒子标签全错了。

previous_answers.headline: 近投时，甲投 10 中 9，乙投 100 中 80；远投时，甲投 100 中 20，乙投 10 中 1。每个距离分别看，谁的命中率更高？把每人的近投和远投合起来算，又是谁更高？为什么排名会变？
previous_answers.headline_en: At short range, A makes 9 of 10 shots and B makes 80 of 100. At long range, A makes 20 of 100 and B makes 1 of 10. Who has the higher hit rate at each distance? Who leads when each player’s shots are combined, and why does the ranking change?
previous_answers.result_en: Who has the higher hit rate?
previous_answers.explanation: 甲近投 90% 对 80%，远投 20% 对 10%，两个距离都领先。合并后，乙是 81/110，甲是 29/110。乙的大多数球是较容易的近投，甲的大多数球是较难的远投，所以总排名反转。
previous_answers.explanation_en: A leads at both distances: 90% versus 80%, then 20% versus 10%. Combined, B leads 81/110 to 29/110. B took mostly easier short shots, while A took mostly harder long shots, reversing the overall ranking.
previous_answers.subject: W47 · 谁的命中率更高？

previous_answers.headline: 校园里有一块长 8 米、宽 6 米的长方形空地。要在空地内选一点作为补给站，使它到四个角的直线距离之和尽可能小。最小值是多少？能达到最小值的位置只有一个吗？请证明。
previous_answers.headline_en: A rectangular school courtyard is 8 m by 6 m. Place a supply station inside it so that the sum of its straight-line distances to the four corners is as small as possible. What is the minimum, and is the location unique? Prove it.
previous_answers.explanation: 到一对对角的距离之和，至少是对角线长 10 米。两对加起来至少 20 米。只有选点同时落在两条对角线上才能同时取等，所以中心是唯一最优点。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The distances to a pair of opposite corners add to at least the 10 m diagonal. Both pairs give a lower bound of 20 m. Equality requires the station to lie on both diagonals, so the centre is the unique optimum.
previous_answers.subject: W47 · 到四个角的路。
